## ShinyApp Module Release Operational Checklist

### Code development
- [ ] @<responsible_person> Development module code - in public GitHub repo - 

### Code review
- [ ] @<reviewer_1> Code review on pull request
- [ ] @<reviewer_2> Code review on pull request

### Data Validation
- [ ] @<responsible_person> Data profiling tool (DPT)
- [ ] @<responsible_person> Validate data sources (e.g. ICES APIs, GitHub)
- [ ] @<responsible_person> Ensure metadata record is updated and consistent

### Content Validation
- [ ] @<responsible_person> Check data consistency and expected outputs
- [ ] @<responsible_person> Make sure app's glossary is updated with relevant terms

### Deployment (Development)
- [ ] @<responsible_person> Deploy to Dev server
- [ ] @<responsible_person> Verify app runs correctly in Dev environment

### Final Review and Approval
- [ ] @<responsible_person> Final review of functionality and outputs
- [ ] @<approver> Approval and green light for production deployment

### Module promotion
- [ ] @<responsible_person> Liase with Comms department to set up relevant prmotion strategy

### Deployment (Production)
- [ ] @<responsible_person> Deploy to Production server
- [ ] @<responsible_person> Smoke test (key features, plots, filters)

### Post-Deployment
- [ ] @<responsible_person> Confirm app accessibility
- [ ] @<responsible_person> Monitor logs / errors after release
